recent_hour: same AEST origin hour; latest mature origins; no additional lookback cap
matched_rule: original HistoryStore.record prefilter: recent eight in chronological order, then stable source-dtype state-distance order with deduplication until sixteen
residual: archived actual(j,h) - archived B(j,h,q50), subtract and take median in FP64
beta_scope: one cross-region R28-selected beta, reused unchanged by Recent16 and Matched16
selection_rule: guard both macro losses against B; minimize objective among eligible grid values including zero; objectives within 1e-12 of the minimum tie and choose smaller beta; no feasible positive beta implies zero
L1_query_policy: purge each calendar year independently, then concatenate those same queries for the combined report
decision: R28 only: positive beta, all integrity checks pass, macro MAE and QS no worse than B and at least one strictly better beyond numeric tolerance; no region has either loss above 1.01 times B; each regional 80/90 coverage absolute deviation from nominal worsens by at most .01. L1 must pass separately for 2023, 2024 and combined.
bootstrap_method: synchronized non-circular moving AEST origin-date blocks; loss sums divided by sampled cell counts within region, then equal-region macro; percentile intervals
budget_policy: strict upper limits; stop at either 8 CPU-core-hours or 3 wall-clock hours, or immediately on failed prerequisite integrity verification
source_path_policy: configuration paths are repository-root-relative except root; runtime manifests resolve source paths absolutely to identify the verified server workspace
limitations: Existing OOF tree versions change on the archived deployment schedule; 2022H1 and 2022H2 do not share one tree. No later tree is used to refill earlier forecasts.
Existing purged OOF gaps and fold-standardized FP32 state coordinates are retained, without reforecasting or rescaling state coordinates across folds.
Only released mature residuals enter controls; query outcomes enter scoring and retrospective strata, never routing.
Full has three neural optimization seeds; B and each simple control are one deterministic forecast, never copied as three independent replications.
2023/2024 are previously inspected periods. Conditional L1 is retrospective forward evaluation, not a new blind test.
Day-block intervals are descriptive under temporal dependence and drift; neither neural seeds nor overlapping forecast cells are independent market samples.
Failure stops this current V5 residual-correction research route under the frozen protocol, not every possible conditional forecasting hypothesis.
Passing both stages makes R28 a mandatory research baseline, not a claim of model novelty or permission to start a gain acceptor or neural retraining.
